start_flamethrower_daemon.description: Whether to start the flamethrower daemon for multicast installs

flamethrower_directory_portbase.description: Port number where the Flamethrower configuration database can be found on the server

interface.description: Network interface used to send data

full_duplex.description: Whether all connections between clients and server are full-duplex

min_clients.description: Minimum number of clients required before casting begins

max_wait.description: Maximum seconds to wait for clients before initiating cast

min_wait.description: Minimum seconds to wait before initiating cast, even if enough clients have connected

nosync.description: Whether to avoid synchronous mode when writing to target

broadcast.description: Whether to use Ethernet broadcast instead of multicast
